units: metres, local X along the garden front and Y into the house
interpretation: Both aerial images show a tiled garden-side mass and a pale lower northern roof. The 2021 image resolves a transverse ridge, diagonal hips and the breaks at the garden facade. The western change in soffit is visible in terrestrial photograph 04. The location of the upper roof in the aerial image is displaced relative to the ground footprint. Ridge endpoints, pitch, eave projections, rear roof heights and the individual tile dimensions are reconstruction estimates. The roof framing, rear windows and internal partition plan have no photographic support.
